scope: Versioned host embedding API and independent embed page

expectedActualCorrections.expected: Typecheck and dual-entry production build pass on the first implementation
expectedActualCorrections.actual: Closure nullability and exactOptionalPropertyTypes rejected nullable host nodes and explicit undefined callbacks
expectedActualCorrections.correction: Created stable non-null aliases and omitted onRetryMedia when absent; typecheck and build passed

expectedActualCorrections.expected: The independent host observation label follows internal Player progress
expectedActualCorrections.actual: The Player reached presenting while the label remained title
expectedActualCorrections.correction: Observed the public data-player-status/host-activity attributes and refreshed the host label

expectedActualCorrections.expected: The host resume control remains pointer-operable above the suspended Player
expectedActualCorrections.actual: The Player suspended overlay z-index 25 covered the host control layer z-index 20
expectedActualCorrections.correction: Raised the external host control layer to z-index 40 and passed pause/resume regression

expectedActualCorrections.expected: Repository-root Vite preview finds the Player production dist
expectedActualCorrections.actual: Preview resolved dist relative to the repository root and refused to start
expectedActualCorrections.correction: Started preview from apps/player-shell and verified the cold production artifact

expectedActualCorrections.expected: Vite config is forward-compatible with native config loading
expectedActualCorrections.actual: The first successful build warned that __dirname is unsupported by the future native loader
expectedActualCorrections.correction: Replaced __dirname with import.meta.dirname; the clean rebuild emitted no Player config warning
